sonnet.about: The chat assistant. Fast and capable for everyday coding.

fable.about: Deepest thinker: planning, architecture, hard design decisions. Slow and expensive, so use it for planning, not routine work.

opus.about: Main developer: writes and changes the code for games, sites, apps and systems.

sol.about: Fast, low-cost OpenAI coder: writing and running tests, code reviews, quick fixes, a second opinion from a different AI.

astra.about: OpenAI's strongest model, and it can generate images: security reviews and hard reviews (payments, logins, user data), and images (thumbnails, hero images, product images, icons).

game.about: Games of any kind: plan, build, an independent review by a different AI, and a thumbnail image.

steps.name: plan
steps.task: You are the planner. Design and structure this game: core loop, controls, screens, art style, tech stack, and the exact file structure. Write it all to PLAN.md in this folder. Do not write any game code.

steps.name: code
steps.task: You are the developer. Read PLAN.md and implement the complete, playable game in this folder exactly as planned. Add a short README.md saying how to run it.

steps.name: review
steps.task: You are the reviewer, a second pair of eyes from a different AI. Read PLAN.md, RULES.md if present, and all the code. Check that the game is complete and playable, matches the plan, and follows the project rules and skills. Fix any bugs or rule violations directly in the code. Then write REVIEW.md: what you checked, what you fixed, and anything left that a human should look at.

steps.name: thumbnail
steps.task: You are the artist. Read PLAN.md and create an eye-catching thumbnail image for this game that matches its art style. Save it as thumbnail.png in this folder.

webapp.about: Web apps with logic and data: e-commerce shops (products, cart, checkout), dashboards, admin panels, booking, anything with accounts or a database. Plan, build, tests, then a security review.

steps.name: plan
steps.task: You are the planner. Design this web app: pages and user flows, data model, API routes, accounts and permissions, how payments work (test mode only, never real keys), tech stack, and the exact file structure. Write it all to PLAN.md in this folder. Do not write any code.

steps.name: code
steps.task: You are the developer. Read PLAN.md and implement the complete, working app in this folder exactly as planned. Add a README.md saying how to install, run and use it, including any test accounts.

steps.name: test
steps.task: You are the tester. Read PLAN.md and the code. Write automated tests for the main features and user flows, run them, and fix any failures in the code. Write TESTS.md: how to run the tests, what they cover, and the results.

steps.name: security
steps.task: You are the security reviewer. Read PLAN.md, RULES.md if present, and all the code. Check logins and sessions, access control, payments, input validation, injection (SQL, XSS, command), secrets in the code, and exposure of user data. Fix the problems you find directly in the code. Write SECURITY.md: what you checked, what you fixed, and what a human must still check.

website.about: Static and content websites: landing pages, portfolios, company, event or product sites, blogs. Plan, build, a review for mobile, accessibility and SEO, then the site's images.

steps.name: plan
steps.task: You are the planner. Plan this website: pages, sections and their content, the design system (colors, fonts, spacing), mobile and desktop layouts, SEO basics, the images it needs, and the exact file structure. Write it all to PLAN.md in this folder. Do not write any code.

steps.name: code
steps.task: You are the developer. Read PLAN.md and build the complete website in this folder exactly as planned, with real content rather than placeholder text where the plan provides it. Add a short README.md saying how to open or deploy it.

steps.name: review
steps.task: You are the reviewer. Read PLAN.md, RULES.md if present, and all the code. Check the layout on a 360px-wide phone and on desktop, accessibility (alt text, labels, color contrast, keyboard use), SEO (page titles, meta descriptions, heading order), and broken links. Fix the problems directly in the code. Write REVIEW.md: what you checked, what you fixed, and what a human should look at.

steps.name: images
steps.task: You are the artist. Read PLAN.md and create the images the site needs that it does not have yet, at least a hero image and a social preview image (og-image.png, 1200x630), in the site's style. Save them in an images/ folder and wire them into the HTML (img tags with alt text, og:image meta tag).

system.about: Backends, APIs, command-line tools, scripts, automations, desktop or internal systems. Plan, build, tests, then a code and security review.

steps.name: plan
steps.task: You are the planner. Design this system: what it does, its parts and how they talk to each other, data storage, configuration, error handling, tech stack, and the exact file structure. Write it all to PLAN.md in this folder. Do not write any code.

steps.name: code
steps.task: You are the developer. Read PLAN.md and implement the complete, working system in this folder exactly as planned. Add a README.md saying how to install, configure and run it.

steps.name: test
steps.task: You are the tester. Read PLAN.md and the code. Write automated tests for the main features and edge cases, run them, and fix any failures in the code. Write TESTS.md: how to run the tests, what they cover, and the results.

steps.name: review
steps.task: You are the reviewer. Read PLAN.md, RULES.md if present, and all the code. Review correctness, error handling, data safety, input validation and secrets. Fix the problems directly in the code. Write REVIEW.md: what you checked, what you fixed, and what a human must still check.

default.about: Anything that fits no other flow: plan, build, then a review by a different AI.

steps.name: plan
steps.task: You are the planner. Plan and structure this job and write the plan to PLAN.md in this folder. Do not implement anything.

steps.name: code
steps.task: You are the developer. Read PLAN.md and implement it completely in this folder.

steps.name: review
steps.task: You are the reviewer, a second pair of eyes from a different AI. Read PLAN.md, RULES.md if present, and all the code. Check that the work is complete and matches the plan. Fix any bugs directly. Write REVIEW.md: what you checked, what you fixed, and anything a human should look at.
